name: boss-9
about: Boss Rush: Undue Influencer (a masked puppeteer with marionette crosses on strings). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss09-influencer-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
